thread:
Sara D: paging: observed spike in model errors and garbled token outputs for several customer requests around 14:03 UTC. high error rate on /v1/generate for model 'redwood-mix-2' canary. rolling canary went from 10%->50% at ~14:00 and error rate jumped. tagging oncall.

incident-bot: Pager triggered: severity=P2, metric=generate.errors.rate, threshold=0.08 -> 0.18; alerted: @oncall-bernie, @deploy-bot.

oncall-bernie: I'm on it. can everyone add short notes here. what are customers seeing?

Lisa (Support): multiple customers reporting weird tokens like "�<|unk|>" and truncated sentences. Example: "We appreciated your serv" then drop. One support ticket from Acme shows corrupted invoice numbers.

Ajay P: Looking at logs — tokenizer mismatch between model bundle and tokenizer config. The new weight bundle references tokenizer v3.1 but runtime pulled tokenizer v2.8 due to artifact tag mismatch.

Kevin L: who pushed the rollout? deploy-bot, what's the diff?

deploy-bot: Deploy job 2026-06-11T14:00Z: image=redwood/serve:release-2026-06-11, model_bundle=rbundle-2026-11-08, tokenizer_tag=tokenizer:v2.8 (expected v3.1). Canary routing: 10%->50% (auto-step at 14:05).

Maria R: Confirmed. The model bundle contains metadata tokenizer_version: "v3.1", but our config resolver pulled an older tokenizer due to a missing mapping in the artifact index (s3://model-artifacts/index.json missing new tag).

Sara D: Impact: several customers on canary experiencing malformed outputs, some data leaks risk low but incorrect content. Recommend immediate rollback and kill-switch for canary.

Ajay P: Agreed. Plan: 1) flip feature flag to route canary traffic back to stable model (kill-switch) 2) pause rollout job 3) initiate rollback for the model bundle 4) investigate artifact index race.

oncall-bernie: Flipping flag now -> `/ff toggle model.canary.routing false`

Kevin L: Flag flipped, traffic back to stable. Observed errors dropping within 30s. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary routing disabled by oncall-bernie at 14:12 UTC. Autoscaler unchanged.

Maria R: Initiating rollback to bundle rbundle-2026-07-21 (previous stable). Creating rollback change set.

Lisa (Support): Notifying top 5 affected customers and creating incident status page. Draft message: "We've reverted a canary rollout that caused garbled outputs; service is on stable and we are investigating. No customer data exfiltration detected so far."

Sara D: Good. Add ETA for full RCA: 24-48 hours. Note to SRE: collect artifact index logs and object versions (S3 list-objects) between 13:50-14:05 UTC.

Ajay P: Quick debug snippet I ran: 
```
# diff between expected tokenizer tag and resolved
jq '.models["redwood-mix-2"].tokenizer' model-manifest.json
# returned: "tokenizer:v3.1"
aws s3api head-object --bucket model-artifacts --key tokenizer/v3.1/tokenizer.tar.gz
# 404 for that key at 13:58 UTC, fallback to tokenizer:v2.8
```

Kevin L: Who had permissions to update index.json? we need owner of that change.

Maria R: Looks like PR #4125 updated index.json but CI artifact publish step failed quietly; index.json made live with new entry pointing to a not-yet-published key. I'll open a postmortem PR.

oncall-bernie: Rollback completed at 14:18 UTC. Monitoring error rate and customer reports.

deploy-bot: Rollback job 1765432275 finished: success. Model service reverted to rbundle-2026-07-21.

Sara D: Current status: mitigation applied (kill-switch + rollback). Customer impact reduced; some users saw corrupted outputs for ~12-15 minutes. Severity remained P2. Next steps: RCA, fix CI artifact publish checks, and add pre-deploy validation to ensure tokenizer key exists before promoting index.json.

Lisa (Support): Posting status update to status.redwood.ai and emailing affected customers. Copy of message posted in #support-updates.

Ajay P: Action items assigned: Maria (CI fix & PR review), Kevin (deploy pipeline check for tag consistency), Sara (RCA draft & contact legal if any potential data issue surfaces), Bernie (follow-up monitoring and runbook update).

Maria R: I'll also add a check in the artifact publisher to verify head-object returns 200 before allowing index.json to be merged. ETA: today EOD for hotfix.

Sara D: Thanks team. leaving notes for postmortem: root cause = index.json promoted referencing tokenizer key not yet published -> runtime resolved fallback tokenizer v2.8 -> mismatch with weights expecting v3.1 -> garbled tokens.

oncall-bernie: closing pager. Re-open if error rate climbs >0.05.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: mitigation=rollback+kill-switch, timeframe=14:03-14:18 UTC, impact=partial (canary users); severity downgraded to P3 after rollback.

Kevin L: Quick retro suggestion: gate canary auto-step on index verification.

Sara D: Agreed. I'll include that in RCA. Closing thread when postmortem PR is up. :white_check_mark:
